ethics.title: Ethics, Standards & Sources
ethics.subtitle: Transparency is at the heart of community health. Here is how we protect your safety and privacy.
ethics.whyNoDiagnosisTitle: Why We Strictly Exclude AI Diagnosis and Symptom Triage
ethics.whyNoDiagnosisText: Underserved communities have historically faced disparities in healthcare access and algorithmic bias. AI medical diagnosis tools frequently hallucinate, misinterpret non-Western symptom descriptions, or recommend inaccessible specialists. By strictly restricting our AI to summarizing pre-vetted official public health text, we eliminate algorithmic risk and prioritize human clinic connection.
ethics.step1: 1. Source Extraction: Sourced exclusively from the World Health Organization (WHO), CDC, NIH, and national health ministries.
ethics.step2: 2. Plain Language Rewriting: Translated to 5th-6th grade reading level, eliminating medical jargon.
ethics.step3: 3. Cultural & Clinical Sign-off: Reviewed by practicing community doctors, nurse practitioners, and health promoters.
ethics.step4: 4. Versioned Publication: Tagged with reviewer name, medical role, and verification date.
